note: P5 LOCKED ledger (Matt IA lock 2026-08-11): destination + visitor_objective + machine_objective + exits per route. Amendments applied: /tools/appreciation kept standing; all /lp/* reclassified SYSTEM-noindex (not cut).

/.visitor_objective: Land on Central Oregon real estate and immediately pick the path that matches my intent — browse homes, explore a place, check the market, or value my home.
/.machine_objective: Route an unqualified visitor into the highest-intent pillar (browse, places, market, or the valuation spine) within one click, so intent declares itself on the very next page.

/about.visitor_objective: Learn who Ryan Realty is — the people, the verified record, the service area — enough to trust the brokerage with a purchase or sale.
/about.machine_objective: Trust established advances contact-made: the convinced visitor exits into the contact, valuation, or browse door carrying that trust, so the eventual lead arrives warm.

/accessibility.visitor_objective: Learn the site's accessibility commitment and report a barrier through a working channel.
/accessibility.machine_objective: Keep the accessibility-compliance posture documented and the barrier-report channel real (single mailbox — defect: it currently splits from the other legal pages' address), protecting every visitor-facing surface's standing.

/account.visitor_objective: Pick up my home search exactly where I left it — everything I saved, and what changed since I was last here.
/account.machine_objective: Bind the visitor to a durable identified account stitched to their CRM record and generate recurring attributable return visits.

/account/areas.visitor_objective: See the places I follow and jump back into any of them.
/account/areas.machine_objective: Convert followed-place state into recurring place-node and search re-entries by the identified lead.

/account/buying-preferences.visitor_objective: Tell the site once what I'm actually looking for so everything it shows and sends me fits.
/account/buying-preferences.machine_objective: Sharpen the identified buyer's intent profile so alerts, matches, and broker follow-up hit the mark.

/account/collections.visitor_objective: Organize the homes I'm considering into named collections I can return to and share.
/account/collections.machine_objective: Deepen the identified lead's persisted state, sharpening intent signal and raising return frequency.

/account/collections/[id].visitor_objective: Work a specific shortlist — compare its homes and step into any of them.
/account/collections/[id].machine_objective: Turn curated shortlist state into listing-detail re-entries and comparison moments by the identified lead.

/account/hidden.visitor_objective: Review homes I hid and un-hide any I've changed my mind about.
/account/hidden.machine_objective: Keep search results honest to the visitor's expressed taste so the browse loop stays trusted and returned-to.

/account/history.visitor_objective: Find a home I looked at before and jump back into it.
/account/history.machine_objective: Recover near-miss intent by routing the identified lead back into listing details they already showed interest in.

/account/notifications.visitor_objective: Control what the site emails me and how often, without unsubscribing from everything.
/account/notifications.machine_objective: Preserve the compliance-clean return channel by giving the lead a pace answer short of the kill switch.

/account/profile.visitor_objective: Keep my contact details and sign-in method current.
/account/profile.machine_objective: Keep the account→CRM identity stitch accurate so attribution and broker follow-up reach the real person.

/account/saved-cities.visitor_objective: Return to the cities I follow.
/account/saved-cities.machine_objective: Same followed-place return loop as /account/areas — duplicated per geo type today.
/account/saved-cities.cut_reason: Portal PDS §11: saved-cities/saved-communities merge into one 'places' concept inside the single account destination — three surfaces for one job. Noindex, so no GSC equity expected; evidence pull still runs per protocol.

/account/saved-communities.visitor_objective: Return to the communities I follow.
/account/saved-communities.machine_objective: Same followed-place return loop as /account/areas — duplicated per geo type today.
/account/saved-communities.cut_reason: Same merge as /account/saved-cities: one saved-places surface per portal PDS §11 consolidation. Noindex; no GSC equity expected, evidence pull still runs.

/account/saved-homes.visitor_objective: Return to the homes I saved and see what changed on them since I was last here.
/account/saved-homes.machine_objective: Convert saved-home state into repeat listing-detail visits and inquiry moments by the identified lead.

/account/saved-searches.visitor_objective: See, rerun, and tune the searches the site is watching for me — including alert pace — in one place.
/account/saved-searches.machine_objective: Keep the identified buyer's alert subscriptions alive and tuned so the return channel keeps re-entering the listing graph instead of being unsubscribed.

/activity.visitor_objective: Watch what just happened in the market — new listings, price cuts, pendings, closings — as a live ledger I can act on.
/activity.machine_objective: Convert market-watching into buyer or seller intent: ledger events deep-link into listing inspection, and the seller-curious watcher exits into the valuation spine.

/alerts/unsubscribe.visitor_objective: Stop these alert emails in one tap, one question.
/alerts/unsubscribe.machine_objective: Execute a compliance-clean exit that preserves trust — and offer the road back into browsing rather than a dead end.

/area-guides.visitor_objective: Pick a place to explore from a curated ledger of cities and communities.
/area-guides.machine_objective: Route into a place node — a job /cities and /communities already do; three chooser surfaces carry two ledgers of content.
/area-guides.cut_reason: Third parallel chooser duplicating the /cities + /communities ledgers (evaluate-a-place PDS §10 names it a duplicate path); the locked places destination is ONE exploration surface. Sitemap-emitted and nav-linked, so it plausibly holds SEO equity — GSC evidence pull REQUIRED before cut; 301 target is the places index.

/areas/[slug].visitor_objective: Explore a broker-drawn custom area with exact map-tool search parity.
/areas/[slug].machine_objective: Hand off into a drawn-area-scoped search — but the family is empty in practice: generateStaticParams returns [], no index links in, absent from nav, depends entirely on broker-created public areas existing.
/areas/[slug].cut_reason: Usage-dependent cut per the PDS destination implication: folds into places only if P4/P5 finds real usage; otherwise cut with a 301 plan. Missing slugs already render noindex and the route is undiscoverable, so SEO equity is likely nil — confirm with the GSC pull plus a live row count of public saved areas before killing.

/auth-error.visitor_objective: Understand why sign-in failed and retry without a dead end.
/auth-error.machine_objective: Salvage a failed auth attempt back into the sign-in flow rather than dropping the return visit.

/blog.visitor_objective: Find the long-form written answer — browse attributed editorial on Central Oregon real estate by category, with Blog+ItemList JSON-LD for machine readers.
/blog.machine_objective: Earn organic and AI-citation entries for the knowledge family (the words leg beside the numbers leg) and route each reader into a post, a place, or a market node.

/blog/[slug].visitor_objective: Read one direct, attributed, plain-language piece — answer above the fold, byline always present, empty bodies never faked.
/blog/[slug].machine_objective: Turn earned reading trust into the next graph step — geo cross-link bands into community inventory, market-report reads, a valuation start, or the author's contact page — offered after the answer, never before it.

/bpo/[slug].visitor_objective: Read the broker price opinion prepared for you — same private, phone-first document read as the CMA, reached by possession of the link.
/bpo/[slug].machine_objective: Stitch the document read to the CRM person and record engagement; P3 must unify the door policy with /cma (identity-gated vs link-possession is today an accident of build order, not a decision).

/builders.visitor_objective: See which builders have active new-construction inventory in Central Oregon.
/builders.machine_objective: Route into a builder node or new-construction search — but the anchor is derived from a free-text MLS field with no registry, and the route sits in neither sitemap nor nav.
/builders.cut_reason: PDS rise-or-die call: builders either rises to the anchor-family floor (facts SoR, map, stats, CTA, capture, discoverability) or is cut to a listing-detail rail only. Never sitemap-emitted and absent from nav (grep-verified), so SEO equity risk is effectively nil — still run the GSC check for internal-link-earned impressions before the kill.

/builders/[slug].visitor_objective: See every active home this builder currently has for sale.
/builders/[slug].machine_objective: Advance to a listing — the only job the stub performs; it has no facts SoR, no map, no stat band, no CTA, and no capture.
/builders/[slug].cut_reason: Thinnest variant in the anchor family (D2): entered only from the listing-detail builder rail, which can absorb the whole job. Rise-or-die per PDS; not sitemap-emitted, so no meaningful SEO equity — confirm with GSC, then cut to the listing-detail rail with 301s to scoped new-construction search.

/buy.visitor_objective: Understand how buying works in Central Oregon — representation, earnest money, timelines, the broker's role — well enough to take the next step with confidence.
/buy.machine_objective: Named buyer lead with intent and timeline (or a listing alert with an email) captured at the moment the education makes reaching out the obvious next move.
/buy.cut_reason: Fold into homes as the buyer-education layer per the locked P5 set and the plan-a-purchase PDS: the hub is orphaned from primary chrome (nav Buy group is /homes-for-sale, no footer link) and adds a hop for every visitor who knows their segment. SEO equity flag: sitemapped priority 0.6 with FAQPage JSON-LD — GSC evidence pull mandatory before any 301.

/buy/[intent].visitor_objective: Understand the buying path that fits my specific situation — first home, relocation, or investment — and hand over my name when the plan makes sense.
/buy/[intent].machine_objective: Named buyer lead carrying segment intent (first-time/relocation/investment) plus timeframe and true first-touch attribution — the one artifact no browse completion produces.
/buy/[intent].cut_reason: Fold as homes buyer-education guides (modes/leaves of the browse destination) per the locked set; the three LPs keep their conversion job but stop being a parallel funnel with duplicate alert capture. SEO equity flag: all three slugs sitemapped (0.55) with per-intent canonicals and FAQPage JSON-LD — GSC evidence per route before any cut/rename; cuts get 301s.

/central-oregon/events.visitor_objective: See Central Oregon's recurring events — confirmed dates only — to gauge what living here feels like through the year.
/central-oregon/events.machine_objective: Route into an event or venue node or capture a regional SFR alert, while the confirmed-dates-only discipline earns event-intent traffic without fabricated schema.

/central-oregon/events/[slug].visitor_objective: Decide whether life around this recurring event's home turf could work — confirmed dates, its venue, and the market around it.
/central-oregon/events/[slug].machine_objective: Advance one graph step (venue, city, or market read entered; listing opened) while Event JSON-LD is emitted only with a real confirmed date.

/central-oregon/golf/[slug].visitor_objective: Decide whether life around this golf course could work — verified course specs, tee-time outlink, and the real homes for sale around it.
/central-oregon/golf/[slug].machine_objective: Advance one graph step — a listing opened, a community node entered (golf's strongest cross-link), or contact — while earning golf long-tail traffic; the golf index moves in-family in the target IA (today the only hub is the ad-owned /lp/central-oregon-golf, with 26 breadcrumbs pointing into ad territory — GSC decides which URL keeps the organic equity, 301 discipline applies).

/central-oregon/trails.visitor_objective: Browse Central Oregon's trail network to find the trail worth living near.
/central-oregon/trails.machine_objective: Route into a trail anchor node or capture a regional SFR alert while earning trail-intent search traffic.

/central-oregon/trails/[slug].visitor_objective: Decide whether life around this trail could work — authoritative linework, verified facts with a lastVerified stamp, and the real homes near the trailhead.
/central-oregon/trails/[slug].machine_objective: Advance one graph step (listing, city, or community node — trails carry community cross-links) while earning long-tail trail-intent traffic; honest empty states exit to city inventory.

/central-oregon/venues.visitor_objective: Browse Central Oregon's music and event venues to find the cultural anchor worth living near.
/central-oregon/venues.machine_objective: Route into a venue anchor node or capture a regional SFR alert while earning venue-intent search traffic.

/central-oregon/venues/[slug].visitor_objective: Decide whether life around this venue could work — verified facts, an outbound link to its real calendar, and the homes for sale near it.
/central-oregon/venues/[slug].machine_objective: Advance one graph step (listing opened, city node or an event page entered via the on-stage-here cross-sell) while the honest outbound calendar link builds trust rather than faking a lineup.

/cities.visitor_objective: Choose which Central Oregon city fits by comparing live inventory, prices, and market pace across every city on one chooser.
/cities.machine_objective: Route the visitor into a specific city node or capture a regional SFR alert, by making the city comparison decisive enough that picking one is the obvious next tap.

/cities/[slug].visitor_objective: Decide whether this city fits — see what's for sale, what it costs, how fast it moves, and what's around it, live.
/cities/[slug].machine_objective: Capture a city-scoped listing alert (email → listing_alerts + crm_people), or hand the visitor into homes or sell with the city context attached, because the page answered the place question well enough that watching or browsing is the natural next step.

/cities/[slug]/[neighborhoodSlug].visitor_objective: Decide whether this neighborhood fits — live inventory, cost, pace, and what daily life near it looks like.
/cities/[slug]/[neighborhoodSlug].machine_objective: Capture a place-scoped listing alert or hand off into homes/sell with neighborhood context, earned by answering the neighborhood question truthfully at this grain.

/clear.visitor_objective: A visitor wedged on a stale pre-cutover service worker's dead cached shell gets fully un-wedged by visiting one URL — Clear-Site-Data wipes cache and storage (cookies preserved) and lands them home in ~1 second.
/clear.machine_objective: Recover otherwise-permanently-lost returning visitors (a wedged shell converts at zero) — the out-of-band backstop to the automatic StaleServiceWorkerReset leg; URL is relayed by support, so it must stay stable.

/cma/[slug].visitor_objective: Read the valuation your broker prepared for you — the number and every comparable behind it, on your phone, private to you.
/cma/[slug].machine_objective: Verify the reader is the intended recipient, capture the one-time SMS/email consent decision, stitch the read and every click to the CRM person, and alert the broker the document landed (alert clause is target, not yet behavior — view-client-valuation-doc D6).

/cma-drafts/[id].visitor_objective: The assigned broker reviews the auto-drafted CMA — lead identity, value + range + confidence, PDF, drafted email — from their phone and sends it to the lead in one tap, no admin login.
/cma-drafts/[id].machine_objective: Move a queued CMA from draft to delivered inside the 24-hour promise via the HMAC-signed review link (the human-approval step in the valuation fulfillment machine).

/communities.visitor_objective: Compare Central Oregon's resort and planned communities side by side to shortlist the ones worth exploring.
/communities.machine_objective: Route the visitor into a community node or capture a regional alert by making the community landscape legible in one pass.

/communities/[slug].visitor_objective: Decide whether this resort/planned community fits — alias-true active count, real median, STR reality, schools, and what membership in the place actually looks like.
/communities/[slug].machine_objective: Capture a community-scoped alert or a buyer contact, or hand off into homes/sell with the community attached — the second-home segment's strongest conversion surface. The duplicate city-prefixed slug space collapses to this canonical URL (308s already live; index-side link generation is the surviving half to fix).

/compare.visitor_objective: Put the homes I'm deciding between side by side, see which one wins on each measure, and hand the comparison to whoever is deciding with me.
/compare.machine_objective: Advance a resolved shortlist into a captured buyer step — the winning listing inspected into a tour/save/alert — and make the shortlist durable so the comparison and its co-decider recipient stop exiting untracked.
/compare.cut_reason: P3 locked compare-homes → find-a-home: no standalone destination — the compare utility folds into the browse system as its shortlist-decision tool. Zero SEO equity blocks this (noindex, deliberately absent from sitemap and site-search; GSC confirmation per standing carve-out). HARD external contract: every already-shared /compare?ids= link must keep resolving (kept or 301'd, never 404'd) — breaking it breaks artifacts in other people's hands. The nav's four 'Compare homes' links stop pretending it is a destination.

/contact.visitor_objective: Reach a Ryan Realty broker with my question or tour request and know exactly when and how they will answer.
/contact.machine_objective: Contact made: serving the ask fully (email plus the question's context) creates an identified, routed, sequence-enrolled crm_people lead carrying listing, intent, and attribution intact.

/cookies.visitor_objective: See exactly which cookies the site sets, what each does, and change or clear consent from this page.
/cookies.machine_objective: Make the consent banner's choices legible and honorable so consent-gated analytics/marketing trackers keep running lawfully; return the visitor to browsing with consent state correct.

/dashboard.machine_objective: Deliver the returning visitor to the one portal without a broken bookmark.
/dashboard.cut_reason: Already an in-app redirect shell to /account (Matt 2026-06-14 Option A); portal PDS §11: /dashboard dies entirely — collapse the shell to a config-level 301. Noindex, no GSC equity expected; evidence pull confirms before deletion.

/dashboard/collections.machine_objective: Preserve the legacy bookmark into the portal's collections surface.
/dashboard/collections.cut_reason: Redirect shell to /account/collections; same /dashboard-dies consolidation — config 301. Noindex.

/dashboard/collections/[id].machine_objective: Preserve deep legacy bookmarks into the portal collection.
/dashboard/collections/[id].cut_reason: Redirect shell in the /dashboard family — config 301 per portal PDS §11. Noindex.

/dashboard/history.machine_objective: Preserve the legacy bookmark into the portal history surface.
/dashboard/history.cut_reason: Redirect shell to /account/history — config 301 per /dashboard consolidation. Noindex.

/dashboard/likes.machine_objective: Preserve the legacy bookmark; likes are merged into saved homes.
/dashboard/likes.cut_reason: Redirect shell to /account/saved-homes — config 301 per /dashboard consolidation. Noindex.

/dashboard/marketing.visitor_objective: An admin reads the Marketing Brain's state — channel dailies, briefs, calendar, decisions, competitor intel — in one gated dashboard.
/dashboard/marketing.machine_objective: Keep the marketing engine auditable by its operator; no public function, no visitor ever lands here.
/dashboard/marketing.cut_reason: Admin-plane surface living in the public /dashboard namespace (which is itself a portal-dup consolidation candidate). Relocate under the /admin plane; admin-gated with zero SEO equity, so the move is free — a 301 or plain move, no GSC pull needed.

/dashboard/marketing/inbox.visitor_objective: An admin audits marketing@ inbox events — sender allowlisting, parser output, dispatch routing, stuck events — read-only.
/dashboard/marketing/inbox.machine_objective: Keep the email-ingest half of the marketing engine observable so stuck events get found; no public function.
/dashboard/marketing/inbox.cut_reason: Same as parent: admin-plane surface in public namespace; relocate under /admin with the marketing dashboard. Zero SEO equity.

/dashboard/notifications.machine_objective: Preserve the legacy bookmark into alert management.
/dashboard/notifications.cut_reason: Redirect shell to /account/notifications — config 301 per /dashboard consolidation. Noindex.

/dashboard/saved.machine_objective: Preserve the legacy bookmark into the portal saved-homes surface.
/dashboard/saved.cut_reason: Redirect shell to /account/saved-homes — config 301 per /dashboard consolidation. Noindex.

/dashboard/searches.machine_objective: Preserve the legacy bookmark into the alert-manager surface.
/dashboard/searches.cut_reason: Redirect shell to /account/saved-searches — config 301 per /dashboard consolidation. Noindex.

/dashboard/settings.machine_objective: Preserve the legacy bookmark into the portal profile surface.
/dashboard/settings.cut_reason: Redirect shell to /account/profile — config 301 per /dashboard consolidation. Noindex.

/data-deletion.visitor_objective: File a data-deletion request — including revoking Facebook/Google app access — through a clearly named channel with a stated 30-day SLA.
/data-deletion.machine_objective: Satisfy the Meta/Google app data-deletion-URL requirement (this URL is externally pinned and un-renamable) so OAuth sign-in and platform app standing survive, keeping the sign-in capture path alive.

/data/market/[geoType]/[geoSlug].visitor_objective: Fetch the live per-geography market pulse as machine-readable JSON with published methodology — the flat-file shape an AI crawler expects — with explicit nulls, never fabricated zeros.
/data/market/[geoType]/[geoSlug].machine_objective: Make the market layer the most citable asset in the region: AI engines cite Ryan Realty's numbers, feeding the market destination's inception; serves explore-market-knowledge as its data face.

/dmca.visitor_objective: A copyright claimant finds the designated agent and the exact notice/counter-notice elements to file, in one page.
/dmca.machine_objective: Preserve DMCA safe-harbor standing for the thousands of MLS photos the browse system serves, so listing media keeps rendering without legal exposure.

/fair-housing.visitor_objective: Understand the brokerage's fair-housing commitment and the correct complaint channel — routed to HUD, the regulator, by design.
/fair-housing.machine_objective: Keep the license's fair-housing compliance surface intact (a HUD-intake officer or reviewer verifying it finds it complete), licensing every consumer-facing process to operate; the deliberate exit is off-site to HUD.

/faq.visitor_objective: Scan the canonical short answers to the questions people actually ask (buying, selling, neighborhoods, working with us) — full answers mounted, one tap deep.
/faq.machine_objective: Win featured snippets and AI answer citations via FAQPage JSON-LD, then route the answered visitor to a report, a conversation, or the valuation spine.

/faq/[slug].visitor_objective: Get one question answered as the first paragraph under the H1 — zero interaction, its own citable URL.
/faq/[slug].machine_objective: Rank and be cited standalone per question (single-question FAQPage JSON-LD) — which requires closing the discovery hole (not in sitemap, zero inbound links outside /faq) — then hand off to a report or conversation.

/feed.visitor_objective: Flick through home videos vertically, phone-first, the way I already consume video.
/feed.machine_objective: Convert vertical-feed browsing into listing inspections — as a MODE of /videos, not a second page.
/feed.cut_reason: P3 lock (Matt 2026-08-11): 'keep /videos, fold /feed' — the grid is the indexable canonical surface and the vertical feed becomes a mode of it. Route disposition is this pass: 301 /feed into /videos (vertical mode). No indexed-equity concern flagged in the PDS, but run the standing GSC check before the 301 lands. Also carries known register drift (legacy-flat SiteFooter) that dies with the fold.

/forgot-password.visitor_objective: Regain access to my account by email in one step.
/forgot-password.machine_objective: Recover a locked-out identified lead back into the return loop instead of losing them.

/homes-for-sale.visitor_objective: Find the homes that match what I can spend and how I want to live — filtered, mapped, and honest about counts and freshness — and know each one well enough to act.
/homes-for-sale.machine_objective: Capture a durable buyer-intent artifact — a guest alert with an email, a saved home on an account, or a tour request — at the moment browsing proves the intent.

/homes-for-sale/[...slug].visitor_objective: Browse live inventory already scoped to my city, community, or neighborhood, with the place/filter context carried in a shareable URL.
/homes-for-sale/[...slug].machine_objective: Convert geo-scoped search intent (organic and internal) into an alert, save, or listing inspection, while the URL preserves the earned SEO equity of every geo segment.

/housing-market.visitor_objective: Get the region-wide answer to "how's the market" — live active count, median, and the months-of-supply verdict, MLS-traced, above the fold with zero interaction.
/housing-market.machine_objective: Convert the free verified answer into a durable channel — market-report subscription, listing alert, valuation start, or broker inquiry — every capture surface positioned after the answer, never as a gate.

/housing-market/[...slug].visitor_objective: Get the same three-tense answer (now, 60-month history, verdict) for one specific city or subdivision, with honest 404s for geographies the data does not cover.
/housing-market/[...slug].machine_objective: Turn a geo-specific trust moment into an alert signup, valuation start, or inquiry tied to that geography, and pass authority into the place and inventory nodes for it.

/housing-market/annual-review.visitor_objective: Read the citable annual reference — rolling-365d figures per geography — at a stable URL built for citation by humans and AI engines.
/housing-market/annual-review.machine_objective: Earn the citation/backlink and hand the reader to a city node, the history explorer, or the valuation spine after the reference is delivered.

/housing-market/central-oregon.visitor_objective: Read the regional roll-up — Central Oregon pulse, price history, and per-city snapshots — as one citable report page.
/housing-market/central-oregon.machine_objective: Anchor regional-intent search and AI citation, then route the reader down to a city node or into a subscription, alert, or valuation after the answer.

/housing-market/history.visitor_objective: Run parameterized closed-sales history queries (year, city, type, feature slices) against the 589K-row licensed dataset — aggregates only, addresses never.
/housing-market/history.machine_objective: Prove the brokerage has data no competitor can fake, so the analyst-grade visitor subscribes, starts a valuation, or asks the broker who evidently has the numbers.

/housing-market/reports.visitor_objective: Scan the current per-city headline cards and range table, and reach any weekly report artifact — all off the same cache so figures cannot disagree.
/housing-market/reports.machine_objective: Convert repeat report readers into subscribers (the email cadence channel) and route city-card clicks into per-geo market nodes.

/housing-market/reports/[slug].visitor_objective: Read one dated weekly market report as a permanent, shareable, citable artifact with Report JSON-LD.
/housing-market/reports/[slug].machine_objective: Be the email click-back landing that sustains the subscription loop, and convert shares and re-reads into alerts, valuations, or inquiries.

/housing-market/reports/[slug]/[geoName].visitor_objective: None — redirect-only stub; the visitor job (per-geo report) is served by /housing-market/<city>.
/housing-market/reports/[slug]/[geoName].machine_objective: Preserve legacy link equity by permanently redirecting the dead reporting_cache-era URL into the live market node.
/housing-market/reports/[slug]/[geoName].cut_reason: Redirect-only re-export of the legacy reporting_cache-era route (app/housing-market/reports/[slug]/[geoName]/page.tsx re-exports the permanentRedirect at app/reports/[slug]/[geoName]/page.tsx). Keep the 301/308 mapping (moved into next.config), delete the page files. No SEO risk — the redirect already carries equity to /housing-market/<city>; route is noindex.

/housing-market/reports/archive/[city].visitor_objective: Browse a city's decade of monthly figures — the past-tense leaf of that city's market node.
/housing-market/reports/archive/[city].machine_objective: Capture long-tail "<city> market history" search intent and route the reader up into the live city node where the conversion surfaces live.

/join.visitor_objective: A Central Oregon broker learns what this brokerage does for their listings and their business, and what joining looks like, enough to start the conversation.
/join.machine_objective: Recruit conversation started: an identified, recruit-tagged contact reaching the principal broker — never a consumer buyer lead, never consumer drip (today's handoff breaks this: join-the-brokerage D1/D2). Off-graph node with its own chrome rule — the footer must not sell the recruit a CMA (D4).

/listing/[listingKey].visitor_objective: Know this specific home well enough to act — price, specs, story, tours, market context, schools, history, and the monthly math.
/listing/[listingKey].machine_objective: Convert proven single-home interest into a tour request, a save, or a like-this alert at the decision moment — this is the #1 ad-landing surface and the node where every capture lives.

/listing/by-address/[...slug].visitor_objective: Reach the exact home I searched or was sent by its human-readable address URL.
/listing/by-address/[...slug].machine_objective: Resolve pretty address URLs onto the canonical listing-detail node so shared links and address-query SEO land on the capture surface, never a 404.

/listing/by-key/[listingKey].visitor_objective: Anyone holding only a listing key (from an alert email, CRM message, or shared link) lands on the canonical listing-detail page for that home.
